name: humid_fan_restrict_1693_blower_dry_after_cooling_runs
description: Blower install, restrict 'heat only': after cooling, a dry house (indoor dew point 50F) lets the blower run as with no restriction
notes: Dew points: indoor 77.0F at 38.8% / 76.0F at 40.1% = ~50F, below the 54F release. Outdoor 70.0F at 49.1% = 50.01F dew point (dry: the #1691 humid-air guard does not block).

Same timeline as humid_fan_restrict_1693_blower_humid_after_cooling_restricted and the same outcomes as hvac_fan_restrict_mode 'both' (the 20:05 fan_running_untracked / backstop reconcile and the 20:10 restart are the unrestricted timeline too, not this feature).

Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: deleting the humid condition (today's 2 h rule) makes 20:00 and 20:30 read paused with no fan_activated. (b) docs-production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'hvac_fan_restrict_mode' states a dry house is not restricted after cooling; production lifts the clause when humidity_facts.hvac_fan_restrict_humid is False. (c) occupant: with a dry house the free blower cooling would be refused for 2 hours for no humidity benefit.
